scope: Prevent a second embedded-MTEXT marker from silently merging into or overwriting an ATTRIB/ATTDEF's first embedded scope.

change.invariant: One ATTRIB or ATTDEF record has at most one parsed Embedded Object scope until a bounded carrier or explicit retention model exists.
change.behavior: DRW_Attrib::parseCode rejects a second code-100 or code-101 Embedded Object marker when mtext already exists.
change.test: Generated ASCII and Binary DXF ATTRIB inputs add a second canonical marker followed by distinct point/text sentinels and require import refusal. Existing single-marker canonical and legacy cases continue to pass.

limitations: Duplicate-marker input is refused; no producer-validity claim is made.
No dedicated user-facing loss diagnostic or opaque retention was added.
Caller-created nested-MTEXT XDATA, DWG host-XDATA conversion, CLI conversion, independent producer evidence, and native consumer acceptance remain open.
